about.title.en: The authorities make many promises. Here’s what happened next.

about.p1.en: Promised. is a project by Roman Evangulov about public statements and their real-world consequences. Each story begins with a promise, forecast, or assurance; then we look at what happened.

about.p2.en: Some statements can be checked against documents and figures. Others need context. That is why each story includes sources: you can see for yourself who said what, and what we compare it with.

about.p3.en: This is an author-curated selection, not a complete catalogue of every promise. It brings together stories that seemed important and can be documented. If we got something wrong or missed context, you can write to us.

about.footer.en: Promised. — see what became of those words.
